question: Which jobs make up a crypto company group and a tokenized market?

items.title: The liquidity-provider gap
kv: Liquidity provider remains an actor-and-receipt watch, not a technology category. The order distinguishes ordinary proprietary LP activity from the Covered Firm lane and requires committed or actually supplied own-account inventory, actual pool activity, compensation records and no-customer-custody evidence. Persistence, replenishment and hedging are separate operating tests, not automatic legal conditions.
No publisher URL is recorded in this row.

record.title: The liquidity-provider gap
fields: Liquidity gap

Liquidity provider remains an actor-and-receipt watch, not a technology category. The order distinguishes ordinary proprietary LP activity from the Covered Firm lane and requires committed or actually supplied own-account inventory, actual pool activity, compensation records and no-customer-custody evidence. Persistence, replenishment and hedging are separate operating tests, not automatic legal conditions.
